en: Ezekiel 42

p.src: 1  Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.

en: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.
u.src: 1  Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.

p.src: 2  Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

ja: 北側の入口に面した部分は
en: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.
u.src: 2  Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

ja: 42:2 一キュビトは、人の腕の中指の先からひじまでの長さで、約18インチ、または46センチメートルである。
en: 42:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

p.src: 3  Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.

en: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.
u.src: 3  Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.

p.src: 4  Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

en: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.
u.src: 4  Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

p.src: 5  Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.

ja: は狭かった。建物の回廊が、
を多く占めていたからである。
en: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.
u.src: 5  Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.

p.src: 6  For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.

ja: がなかった。そのため、上の階は
よりも奥に引っ込んでいた。
en: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.
u.src: 6  For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.

p.src: 7  The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

en: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.
u.src: 7  The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

p.src: 8  For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

en: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.
u.src: 8  For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

p.src: 9  From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

ja: るための東側の入口があった。
en: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.
u.src: 9  From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

p.src: 10  In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

ja: 、東側の別区画と建物に面する所にも
en: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.
u.src: 10  In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

p.src: 11  The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

ja: じ外観であった。部屋の長さと幅は同じで、すべての
en: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.
u.src: 11  The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

p.src: 12  Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

ja: があった。その通路は東側の壁の正面にあり、そこから部屋に入るようになっていた。
en: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.
u.src: 12  Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

p.src: 13  Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

ja: のきよめのささげ物、罪過のささげ物を
なるものだからである。
en: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
u.src: 13  Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

p.src: 14  When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”

ja: った後、務めのために着た衣服をそこで脱いで置くまでは、
てはならない。それらの衣服は
なるものだからである。それから
づかなければならない。」
en: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”
u.src: 14  When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”

p.src: 15  Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

en: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.
u.src: 15  Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

p.src: 16  He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

en: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.
u.src: 16  He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

p.src: 17  He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

en: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.
u.src: 17  He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

p.src: 18  He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

en: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
u.src: 18  He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

p.src: 19  He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

en: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
u.src: 19  He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

p.src: 20  He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

ja: なるものとを分けていた。
en: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.
u.src: 20  He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.
